topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I took a long, slow sniff of the air, the familiar forest scent a balm. My paws shuffled on the leaf-strewn ground, a rhythm of steps I've known since my eyes first opened. I remember creeping into the den where the soft, furless one kept the warm, cloth creature. The den was quiet, the air heavy with the scent of what used to be. I held the cloth creature in my mouth, the fabric mingling with the taste of the wild. I carried it far, deeper into the woods, where the scent of the furless one would never reach. The cloth creature lay still, now under the moss, a secret buried with the passing seasons.
